events.speaker: customer
events.text: The refrigerator in the basement is making a loud hum, and the food compartment feels warmer than usual. I noticed it last night after putting groceries away.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Have you seen water leaking from the refrigerator or pooling on the floor? Please do not move it if that would be unsafe.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I have not seen any water. I also have not checked behind it, so I cannot tell whether there is a leak near the hose.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Do you have a preferred time for a technician to visit? We can record a general window and follow up to confirm availability.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I need to check my calendar before I can give you a time. I do not want to guess and then have to change the appointment later.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Would you like a quote before the technician arrives, and do you have a spending limit you want us to note?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I do not know what the repair will cost, and I have not decided whether I need a quote before the technician comes. I will discuss that after the inspection.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: That is fine. I will leave the appointment, quote preference, and spending limit unanswered until you have more information.
